india5.title: Manipur villager who went to collect firewood shot dead in Kangpokpi district
india5.description: The local body described it as a matter of serious concern and asked for a thorough and impartial investigation by the competent authority

india5.title: Why AAP refreshed attack on Cong before INDIA bloc's big Delhi meet: Reason lies further north
india5.description: The one big state where Arvind Kejriwal's party and the Congress remain locked in a live, direct contest is Punjab.

india5.title: 24 Indians rescued by Oman Air Force from burning tanker after US Navy strike
india5.description: The shipping ministry coordinated with MEA, the Indian mission in Oman, the defence ministry and Indian Navy to ensure the safety of the crew members

india5.title: 'Meetings inside a car': BJP's Sambit Patra hits out at INDIA bloc, casts doubts on opposition unity
india5.description: BJP MP Sambit Patra made sharp remarks against Leader of the Opposition in Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, saying in his presence ‘no one’s future will prosper'.

india5.title: CID issues 3rd summons to TMC’s Abhishek Banerjee in signature forgery case
india5.description: The two legislators alleged that signatures of several TMC MLAs were forged on a May 19 resolution nominating Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay as the assembly’s LoP

india6.title: President Murmu to confer Padma awards on June 23
india6.description: The President has approved the conferment of 131 Padma awards this year, including to actors Mammootty and R. Madhavan, as well as the late Satish Shah, whose kin will receive the honour posthumously

india6.title: CM Omar Abdullah seeks INDIA bloc’s support for J&K Statehood restoration
india6.description: “If Mr. Abdullah and Mehbooba Mufti [of the Peoples Democratic Party] succeed in persuading the INDIA bloc to issue a joint statement supporting the restoration of Jammu and Kashmir’s special constitutional status, Statehood and other political rights, it would be a significant step,” said Awami Itt

india6.title: West Bengal joins Ayushman Bharat scheme
india6.description: “The portability feature of PM-JAY would be particularly beneficial for migrant workers from West Bengal and their families. Beneficiaries working or residing in other States would be able to access cashless treatment at nearby empanelled hospitals across the countr,’’ said Union Health Minister J.P

india6.title: Rajya Sabha polls: M.P. Congress mulls moving MLAs away as BJP fields candidate on third seat
india6.description: The BJP’s move pushed the Congress into alert mode with Leader of Opposition in the Assembly Umang Singhar hosting party MLAs and senior leaders over dinner at his residence and to discuss the election strategy.

india6.title: Monsoon enters South Konkan, State advises farmers to defer sowing
india6.description: The Agriculture and Disaster Management Department has forecast rainfall in parts of Sindhudurg and Ratnagiri districts until June 9; in other regions of Maharashtra, the monsoon’s progress and rainfall intensity are expected to remain low over the next week.

india6.title: PDP leaders plough paddy fields to protest govt. takeover  of land from farmers in Pulwama
india6.description: Shabir Ahmad, a farmer from Pulwama’s Padgampora, said small patches of 3-4 kanals of land were being utilised by locals to procure rice and feed for cattle; “If the government takes the land, it will have a severe impact on locals,” said Mr. Ahmad.

india6.title: 28 lakh candidates for 32,679 vacancies: Oppn. attacks U.P. govt. over ‘mounting unemployment’
india6.description: According to the Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB), 28,86,797 candidates have applied to compete for 32,679 vacancies over three days (June 8, 9 and 10) across the State.

india6.title: President Murmu confers 7 Kirti Chakras; IAF pilot, Gaganyatri Prasanth Nair among recipients
india6.description: Lt. Commander Dilna K. and Lt. Commander Roopa A. of the Navy are among the Shaurya Chakra recipients after completion of Navika Sagar Parikrama II; Sepoy Janjal Pravin Prabhakar of the Mahar Regiment of Rashtriya Rifles and Lt. Shashank Tiwari of the Sikkim Scouts have been conferred the Kirti Chak

india6.title: SGPC gets visas for 541 Sikh pilgrims to travel to Pakistan on martyrdom anniversary of Guru Arjan Dev
india6.description: During the visit, the pilgrims will pay obeisance at various historic Sikh shrines and participate in commemorative events before returning to India on June 19

india6.title: INDIA bloc to take SIR complaints to CJI; seeks Pradhan’s immediate exit
india6.description: It urges Centre to convene all-party meeting on current economic situation; parties question Congress for parting ways with DMK and for criticising then Pinarayi govt.

india6.title: Operation P-Hunt: 18 cases booked, two arrested in Ernakulam
Kadavanthra police to record actor Ansiba’s statement
Toofan gains momentum as police intensify anti-drug operations in Ernakulam
india6.description: Within Kochi city limits, police recorded 129 cases and arrested 145 accused under the NDPS Act in the week since the operation began on June 1. In Perumbavoor, 11 migrant labourers were arrested for drug peddling and consumption during a day-and-night raid on Sunday

india6.title: The trust deficit in India-Bangladesh ties
india6.description: Bangladeshi diplomats have pointed out that Dhaka expected less rhetoric on illegal immigration, and more focus on issues such as the renewal of the 1996 Ganga Water Treaty

india6.title: Seven Indians killed, nine hurt in Dubai road accident
india6.description: The accident resulted in seven fatalities and nine injuries, including five serious and four moderate injuries, the Dubai Police said, while adding that all injured were transported to the hospital for treatment

india6.title: MP reviews facilities at Dwaraka RTC Complex

india7.title: Six Indians among eight killed in Dubai bus accident
india7.description: Eight people, including six Indians, died in a minibus crash on Dubai's Emirates Road when it hit a truck, with five of the eight injured remaining critical.

india7.title: Ship with 24 Indian sailors catches fire off Oman coast
india7.description: A fire on the Madagascar-flagged Marivex off Oman's coast saw 24 Indian sailors rescued safely. Indian and Omani authorities coordinated the successful effort, with the vessel carrying no cargo.

india7.title: TMC unrest deepens as dissident MPs meet in Delhi during Mamata's INDIA conclave visit
india7.description: Dissident TMC MPs met secretly in Delhi, discussing future actions and dissatisfaction with leadership, following recent legislative party turmoil and an MP's resignation, intensifying speculation about internal party realignments.

india7.title: Kangana Ranaut calls nurses' profession 'most sexualised', says uniform should be Indianised
india7.description: Kangana Ranaut faced backlash for suggesting nurses' uniforms, originating from the British era, contribute to the profession's sexualisation and imply a need for change.

india7.title: Kerala’s white paper: Five discontents
india7.description: Kerala's fiscal health report is a valuable assessment of its challenges, recommending expenditure management and tax reforms, though it overlooks cooperative sector issues and contextually presents debt.

india7.title: Iran, Israel trade strikes for first time since truce as conflict hits 100 days
india7.description: Iran launched missiles at Israel, which intercepted them; Israel then struck targets in Iran, prompting a warning from Iran about wider strikes if aggression repeats.

india7.title: 7.8-magnitude quake strikes Philippines, triggers tsunami warnings
india7.description: A powerful 7.8 magnitude earthquake off the Philippines caused fatalities, injuries, and building collapses, triggering tsunami alerts for the region.

india7.title: Domestic LPG price hiked by ₹29 per cylinder
india7.description: Domestic cooking gas prices rose by ₹29 per cylinder on June 7, the second increase in three months, as retailers face losses due to elevated global energy costs.

india7.title: Centre resumes controversial move for deep-sea mining in Andamans; Kerala, Gujarat next
india7.description: The UK government is reviving controversial deep-sea mining projects in the Andaman-Nicobar, Porbandar, and Kerala regions, modifying the Andaman project to offer larger mining areas to attract industry interest.

india7.title: Cockroach Janata Party's Abhijeet Dipke joins youth for massive protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi
india7.description: Abhijeet Dipke, leading the Cockroach Janta Party, urged peaceful protest at Jantar Mantar demanding exam accountability, with Sonam Wangchuk vowing to fast if Dipke is arrested.
